findings.title: Both new entry bodies reject a fresh caller-selected JDBC implicit transaction
evidence: Both entry bodies test physical @@TRANCOUNT before accepted usp_require_transaction V10 can materialize the caller-selected implicit transaction.
SqlServerExecutor calls request_context then business RPC; request_context only sets SESSION_CONTEXT and contains no table read.
SqlServerPatientStore.link enters TransactionTemplate without a preceding business read; Access.write checks in-memory actor/tenant/modules.
C0 section1 explicitly preserves V10 transaction semantics and first-write support.
findings.inference: A fresh setAutoCommit(false) connection can enter either RPC with @@TRANCOUNT=0 and receive51000 before its accepted V10 boundary. This inference is from code and documented SQL/JDBC semantics, not a new engine execution.
findings.requestedFix: Use the accepted V10 helper to materialize only a caller-selected implicit transaction before requiring a committable external transaction in both new procedure bodies. Preserve autocommit/doom rejection and caller-owned commit/rollback; migration preflight stays unchanged.

limits: Static inspection and hashes do not prove SQL compilation, locking, CAS, permission enforcement, audit or JDBC execution.
